estate_enquiries_budget_check.name: estate_enquiries_budget_check
estate_enquiries_budget_check.value: ("real_estate_enquiries"."budget_min" is null or "real_estate_enquiries"."budget_min" > 0) and ("real_estate_enquiries"."budget_max" is null or "real_estate_enquiries"."budget_max" > 0) and ("real_estate_enquiries"."budget_min" is null or "real_estate_enquiries"."budget_max" is null or "real_estate_enquiries"."budget_max" >= "real_estate_enquiries"."budget_min")

estate_enquiries_reachable_check.name: estate_enquiries_reachable_check
estate_enquiries_reachable_check.value: ("real_estate_enquiries"."contact_method" = 'email' and nullif("real_estate_enquiries"."email", '') is not null) or ("real_estate_enquiries"."contact_method" in ('phone', 'whatsapp') and nullif("real_estate_enquiries"."phone", '') is not null)

client_contacts_reachable_check.name: client_contacts_reachable_check
client_contacts_reachable_check.value: nullif(trim("client_contacts"."email"), '') is not null or nullif(trim("client_contacts"."phone"), '') is not null

opportunities_closed_check.name: opportunities_closed_check
opportunities_closed_check.value: "opportunities"."stage" not in ('won', 'lost') or "opportunities"."closed_at" is not null

quotation_items_values_check.name: quotation_items_values_check
quotation_items_values_check.value: "quotation_items"."position" >= 0 and "quotation_items"."quantity" > 0 and "quotation_items"."unit_price" >= 0 and "quotation_items"."discount_amount" >= 0 and "quotation_items"."tax_rate" between 0 and 100 and "quotation_items"."tax_amount" >= 0

quotation_versions_accepted_check.name: quotation_versions_accepted_check
quotation_versions_accepted_check.value: "quotation_versions"."status" <> 'accepted' or ("quotation_versions"."accepted_at" is not null and nullif(trim("quotation_versions"."accepted_by_name"), '') is not null)

projects_dates_check.name: projects_dates_check
projects_dates_check.value: "projects"."starts_on" is null or "projects"."due_on" is null or "projects"."due_on" >= "projects"."starts_on"

tasks_milestone_project_check.name: tasks_milestone_project_check
tasks_milestone_project_check.value: "tasks"."milestone_id" is null or "tasks"."project_id" is not null

credit_note_items_values_check.name: credit_note_items_values_check
credit_note_items_values_check.value: "credit_note_items"."position" >= 0 and "credit_note_items"."quantity" > 0 and "credit_note_items"."unit_price" >= 0 and "credit_note_items"."discount_amount" >= 0 and "credit_note_items"."tax_rate" between 0 and 100 and "credit_note_items"."tax_amount" >= 0

credit_notes_issued_check.name: credit_notes_issued_check
credit_notes_issued_check.value: "credit_notes"."status" = 'draft' or ("credit_notes"."number" is not null and "credit_notes"."issued_at" is not null and "credit_notes"."total" > 0)

invoice_items_values_check.name: invoice_items_values_check
invoice_items_values_check.value: "invoice_items"."position" >= 0 and "invoice_items"."quantity" > 0 and "invoice_items"."unit_price" >= 0 and "invoice_items"."discount_amount" >= 0 and "invoice_items"."tax_rate" between 0 and 100 and "invoice_items"."tax_amount" >= 0

invoices_billing_purpose_uq.name: invoices_billing_purpose_uq
invoices_billing_purpose_uq.where: "invoices"."quotation_version_id" is not null and "invoices"."billing_purpose" is not null

invoices_issued_check.name: invoices_issued_check
invoices_issued_check.value: "invoices"."status" = 'draft' or (nullif(trim("invoices"."number"), '') is not null and "invoices"."issued_at" is not null and "invoices"."total" > 0)

invoices_void_check.name: invoices_void_check
invoices_void_check.value: "invoices"."status" <> 'void' or ("invoices"."voided_at" is not null and nullif(trim("invoices"."void_reason"), '') is not null)

payment_refunds_completed_check.name: payment_refunds_completed_check
payment_refunds_completed_check.value: "payment_refunds"."status" <> 'completed' or ("payment_refunds"."completed_at" is not null and "payment_refunds"."processed_by_id" is not null)

payments_confirmed_check.name: payments_confirmed_check
payments_confirmed_check.value: "payments"."status" <> 'confirmed' or ("payments"."confirmed_at" is not null and "payments"."confirmed_by_id" is not null and "payments"."receipt_number" is not null)

payments_provider_reference_check.name: payments_provider_reference_check
payments_provider_reference_check.value: "payments"."provider_transaction_id" is null or "payments"."provider" is not null

expenses_approval_check.name: expenses_approval_check
expenses_approval_check.value: "expenses"."status" not in ('approved', 'paid') or ("expenses"."approved_by_id" is not null and "expenses"."approved_at" is not null)

properties_dimensions_check.name: properties_dimensions_check
properties_dimensions_check.value: ("properties"."bedrooms" is null or "properties"."bedrooms" >= 0) and ("properties"."bathrooms" is null or "properties"."bathrooms" >= 0) and ("properties"."area_square_metres" is null or "properties"."area_square_metres" > 0)

ai_agent_runs_tokens_check.name: ai_agent_runs_tokens_check
ai_agent_runs_tokens_check.value: ("ai_agent_runs"."input_tokens" is null or "ai_agent_runs"."input_tokens" >= 0) and ("ai_agent_runs"."output_tokens" is null or "ai_agent_runs"."output_tokens" >= 0)

ai_agent_runs_completed_check.name: ai_agent_runs_completed_check
ai_agent_runs_completed_check.value: "ai_agent_runs"."status" <> 'completed' or ("ai_agent_runs"."scope_approved" = true and "ai_agent_runs"."completed_at" is not null)

automation_outbox_lease_check.name: automation_outbox_lease_check
automation_outbox_lease_check.value: "automation_outbox"."status" <> 'processing' or ("automation_outbox"."locked_at" is not null and "automation_outbox"."locked_by" is not null and "automation_outbox"."lease_expires_at" > "automation_outbox"."locked_at")
